video_caption: The video segment opens with a dynamic blue background filled with numerous white, outlined icons representing various social media platforms, technology brands, and generic symbols (including Pinterest, Apple, Windows, Vimeo, YouTube, Instagram, Dropbox, LinkedIn, and more) floating and shifting. White text appears on the screen, first stating "BRO SCIENCE," "FAKE KNOWLEDGE," and "HALF INFORMATION," followed by "PROPAGANDA," suggesting a theme of misinformation online. The icons then blur into a bokeh effect as a hexagonal outline appears centrally, enclosing the white text "Dr.Education" and "Simplified Medical Explanations." This transitions into a circular blue logo featuring a white stethoscope forming a circle around the text "Dr. DUCATION." Around this central logo, a yellow notification bell icon, a red "Subscribe" button with a white arrow, and various scientific icons like a DNA helix, a test tube, chemical structures, and a red and white pill capsule appear. The blue background and icons then quickly fade to a plain white background, revealing a man wearing a blue scrub top, a dark blue turban, and glasses, with a black beard, and a stethoscope around his neck. He looks directly at the camera with a calm expression. Overlaid text identifies him as "Dr.Paramjeet Singh: Consultant Physician & Non Invasive Cardiologist" at the top, and in Hindi at the bottom, "डॉ परमीत सिंह : कंसल्टेंट फिजिशियन और नॉन इनवेसिव कार्डियोलॉजिस्ट" (Dr. Parmeet Singh: Consultant Physician and Non-Invasive Cardiologist).

The video opens with a man, presumably Dr. Paramjeet Singh, dressed in blue scrubs and a black turban, sitting against a plain white background. He has a beard, glasses, and a stethoscope around his neck. Throughout the segment, he uses various hand gestures while speaking, often holding up three fingers or gesturing with an open palm, maintaining a focused and explanatory expression. At the top of the screen, text reads "Dr.Paramjeet Singh: Consultant Physician & Non Invasive Cardiologist," while at the bottom, "डॉ परमजीत सींह : कंसल्टेंट फजि़शियन और नॉन इनवेसिव कार्डियोलोजिस्ट" (Dr. Paramjeet Singh: Consultant Physician and Non-Invasive Cardiologist) appears in Hindi. From 0:05 to 0:23, a translucent overlay of a YouTube interface showing a list of videos appears on the left side of the screen. During this period, additional text pops up in the middle: "Checkout other health videos on all three dr.education channels," and at the bottom, "Search your health topic with Dr.Education on Youtube" is displayed, followed by its Hindi translation "dr.education लखि के बपिय Youtube पर सर्च करें" (Search for dr.education on YouTube). The YouTube overlay then fades out, leaving the man speaking directly to the viewer. At 0:32, the scene transitions with a white brushstroke effect across a blue textured background, revealing the title of the video: "FUNGAL SKIN INFECTION (RINGWORM) / Why its happens / How to Diagnose it / What can you do about it / Explained By Dr.Paramjeet," presented in yellow cursive and bold white text.

The video segment opens with a man, presumably a doctor, wearing blue scrubs, a black turban, and glasses, with a stethoscope draped around his neck. He has a full beard and is gesturing with both hands while speaking. The background is a plain white wall. At the top of the screen, text reads, "This Video is Available in ENGLISH & HINDI Languages in the same Channel," and at the bottom, "यह video hindi और english दोनों भाषाओं में मौजूद है" (This video is available in both Hindi and English languages). A graphic on the lower-left identifies him as "Physician & Cardiologist DR. PARAMJEET SINGH." At 0:07, a white overlay appears on the right side of the screen with the heading "# KEY POINTS" and the text: "Related ringworm infections may be found: In a man's beard, In the groin (jock itch), Between the toes (athlete's foot), Other places on the skin." The doctor continues to explain and gesture towards the camera. At 0:20, the overlay changes to a detailed anatomical diagram of a human body with numbered arrows pointing to various body parts, illustrating different types of ringworm infections like "Scap Ringworm Tinea capitis," "Ringworm of beard area Tinea barbae or Barber's itch," "Tinea versicolor," "Ringworm of the body Tinea corporis," and "Ringworm of the toes Tinea pedis or Athlete's foot," along with a text box for "Groin Ringworm Tinea cruris Jock Itch Crotch rot (no image due to sensitive nature)." A "FOLLOW ME!" banner with "instagram/dr. education" is also visible at the top-left of this graphic. The man maintains eye contact with the camera and continues his expressive hand gestures while talking.

A man with a beard, glasses, and a dark blue turban, wearing a blue scrub top and a stethoscope, speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands to emphasize his points; his hands move from clasped, to spread, to forming small circles, a thumbs-up, two fingers up, then back to clasped or small circles throughout the segment, conveying a serious and informative tone. The background is a plain white wall, suggesting a professional setting. Overlaying text at the top reads "This Video is Available in ENGLISH & HINDI Languages in the same Channel" (English, indicating multilingual content) which later changes to "Search your health topic with Dr.Education on Youtube" (English, guiding viewers to search for content). On the left, a purple box displays "FOLLOW ME!" (English) above "instagram/dr.education" (English, a social media handle), which is later joined by "Facebook/dreducation". Below these, "# KEY POINTS" (English) is introduced, followed by a bulleted list: "Fungi are germs that can live on the dead tissue of the hair, nails and outer skin layers. The fungi grow well in warm, moist areas." (English, explaining what fungi are and where they thrive). At 0:23, a cartoon graphic of a child's torso with a red, ring-shaped rash on the chest appears on the bottom left, illustrating ringworm. At 0:25, text appears at the top identifying the speaker: "Dr.Paramjeet Singh : Consultant Physician & Non Invasive Cardiologist" (English). Throughout the segment, Hindi text appears at the bottom, first reading "यह video hindi और english दोनों भाषाओं में मौजूद है" (English translation: "This video is available in both Hindi and English languages," reinforcing the multilingual aspect) and then "लखे वपयि youtube पर सरच करन है" (English translation: "Type and search on YouTube," guiding viewers to search). Finally, at 0:37, "Whatsapp @ 7827570775 - To Consult Online / Contact / Book Appointments" (English) is displayed at the bottom, providing contact information.

A man identified as Dr. Paramjeet Singh, a Consultant Physician and Non-Invasive Cardiologist, is featured in the video, wearing a blue scrub suit, a black turban, glasses, and a stethoscope, and is actively gesturing with his hands while speaking. He is seated in front of a plain white background. Throughout the video, text appears on the left side of the screen, initially (00:00-00:04) displaying "# KEY POINTS Fungi are germs that can live on the dead tissue of the hair, nails and outer skin layers. The fungi grow well in warm, moist areas." Below this, contact information is shown: "Whatsapp @ 7827570775 - To Consult Online / Contact / Book Appointments." From 00:04 to 00:26, the key points update to "# KEY POINTS you are more likely to have fungal infection if you: Have minor skin or scalp injuries Do not bathe or wash your hair often Have wet skin for a long time (such as from sweating) Dementia, delirium peripheral neuropathy." During these segments, an informational banner appears at the top (00:11-00:17, 00:20-00:30) stating "Our Information is Referenced from US National Medical Library," and a Hindi translation appears at the bottom (00:04-00:38) reading "यह सारी जानकारी USA की नेशनल मेडिकल् लाईब्रेरी से ली गयी है" (This entire information has been taken from the US National Medical Library). From 00:18 to 00:38, a "FOLLOW ME!" section with "Twitter/Dr_Education" is added on the left, and a "Dr.Education Simplified Medical Explanations" logo appears on the bottom right (00:31-00:38). Concurrently, a warning at the top (00:31-00:38) states: "85% of online health information is Wrong! Always Research."

A man with a black beard and a blue turban, wearing a blue scrub suit and a stethoscope around his neck, sits in front of a plain white wall, speaking directly to the camera and gesturing with his hands throughout the segment. At the top of the screen, the text "85% of online health information is Wrong! Always Research" is displayed in English, with the Hindi translation "इंटरनेट पर हेल्थ की ८५% जानकारी गलत होती है ! हमेशा रिसर्च करें" (85% of health information on the internet is wrong! Always research.) below it, emphasizing caution with online medical advice. From 0:01 to 0:13, a teal-colored text box appears at the bottom left, stating "EDUCATION" and "FACEBOOK/DREDOCATION," with "follow me on facebook" underneath, indicating the speaker's educational and social media presence. From 0:13 to the end of the segment, a text box on the right lists "# KEY POINTS" regarding ringworm transmission: "You can catch ringworm if you come into direct contact with an area of ringworm on someone else's body. You can also get it if you touch items such as combs, hats, or clothing that have been used by a patient. Can also be spread by pets, Especially cats." From 0:19, contact information "whatsaap on 7827570775 to Contact, Consult & Appointments" is shown at the top right, and from 0:21, the Hindi translation "डॉ. से संपर्क, परामर्श, या अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए ७८२७५७०७७५ पर व्हाट्सअप करें" (Contact, consult, or for an appointment with the doctor, WhatsApp at 7827570775) appears at the bottom right. At 0:34, while the man continues speaking, four illustrative images of ringworm appear on the screen, showing "Ringworm on the back," "Ringworm on the arm," "Ringworm on the scalp," and a larger close-up of "Ringworm on the arm," visually detailing the discussed condition.

In this video segment, a man with a beard and a blue turban, wearing blue scrubs and a stethoscope, speaks directly to the camera, using various hand gestures. He is positioned in front of a plain white background. At the top of the screen, text reads "whatsaap on 7827570775 to Contact, Consult & Appointments". Below this, initially, three smaller images display different manifestations of ringworm: "Ringworm on the back", "Ringworm on the arm", and "Ringworm on the scalp". A larger image on the left shows a red, scaly, ring-shaped rash on skin, with "SFS" in the bottom left corner. At the bottom left, a purple "SUBSCRIBE" button with "Dr. EDUCATION FOR MORE" is visible, and beneath it, Hindi text states: "डॉ. से संपर्क, परामर्श, या अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए ७८२७५७०७७५ पर व्हाट्सअप करें" (To contact, consult, or for appointments with the doctor, WhatsApp on 7827570775). Around the 00:10 mark, the top text changes to "Like & Share our Videos to Friends & Spread Health Awareness", and a list of "# KEY POINTS" appears on the left, describing ringworm symptoms: "The rash begins as a small area of red, raised spots and pimples. The rash slowly becomes ring-shaped, with a red, raised border and a clearer center. The border may look scaly. The rash may occur on the arms, legs, face, or other exposed body areas. The area may be itchy." At 00:18, a small cartoon illustration of a boy with a ring-shaped rash on his chest is added below the key points. The man continues to explain and gesture, appearing earnest and informative. Towards the end of the segment (00:34), the bottom Hindi text changes to "अधिक जानकारी" (For More Information).

A man with a dark blue turban, glasses, and a dark beard, wearing a blue scrub top and a stethoscope, is sitting in front of a white wall. He is gesturing with his hands as he speaks. From 00:04 to 00:09, a dynamic graphic on the left shows "Dr.Education SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE VIDEOS" in white text on a colorful purple and blue background. Overlaid at the top of the screen is "For More Info - Subscribe all 3 Dr.Education Channels - Links in Description," and at the bottom in Hindi: "अधिक जानकारी के लिए- नीचे दिए डॉ एजुकेशन के तीनो चैनलों को सब्सक्राइब करें" (For more information - subscribe to all three Dr. Education channels given below). Around 00:09, the graphic on the left is replaced by a list of "KEY POINTS" detailing various "Tests:" including "Examination of a skin," "Scraping from the rash under a microscope using KOH mount," "Skin culture for fungus," and "Skin biopsy." The man continues to gesture, demonstrating actions like scraping skin. From 00:25, the "KEY POINTS" text fades out, and around 00:26, the top text changes to "Search your health topic with Dr.Education on Youtube," while the bottom Hindi text changes to "dr.education लखि के वपिय topic youtube पर सर्च करें" (Search your health topic on YouTube for dr.education). The man continues to explain, using hand gestures to emphasize his points.

The scene features a man with a beard and a dark turban, wearing a blue scrub top and a stethoscope, sitting against a plain white background. He actively gestures with both hands as he speaks, conveying information. Text overlays appear on the screen, initially from 0:04 to 0:06, the top text reads "Search your health topic with Dr.Education on Youtube," while the bottom text says "dr.education लखि के ववपि topic youtube पर सरच् करें" (Search for dr.education and your topic on YouTube), both encouraging viewers to find health topics on YouTube. From 0:06 to 0:36, the left side of the screen displays key treatment information: "# KEY POINTS TREATMENT: Keep your skin clean and dry. Use creams that treat fungal infections. Creams that contain miconazole, clotrimazole, ketoconazole, terbinafine, or oxiconazole, or other antifungal medicine are effective in controlling ringworm." During this period, from 0:28 to 0:36, the top text changes to "For More Info - Subscribe all 3 Dr.Education Channels - Links in Description," and the bottom text reads "अधिक जानकारी के लिए - नीचे दीए ड" (For more information - D given below), which appears truncated. From 0:36 to 1:04, the left-side text changes to detailed instructions on medication usage: "# KEY POINTS TREATMENT: To use this medicine: Wash and dry the area first. Apply the cream, beginning just outside the area of the rash and moving toward the center. Be sure to wash your hands and dry your hands afterward. Use the cream twice a day for 7 to 10 days. Do not use a bandage over ringworm." Simultaneously, from 0:50 to 1:04, a warning appears at the top: "85% of online health information is Wrong! Always Research," mirrored by the bottom text: "इंटरनेट पर हेल्थ की ८५% जानकारी गलत होती है! हमेशा रसिर्च करें" (85% of health information on the internet is wrong! Always research). Finally, from 1:04 to 1:17, the left-side text is replaced by a colorful graphic displaying "Dr.Education SUBSCRIBE FOR MORE VIDEOS," while the top and bottom warning texts persist, emphasizing the importance of researching online health information. The man continues to speak and gesticulate throughout the segment.

From 00:04 to 00:29, a man in a blue scrub top, dark blue turban, glasses, and a beard is speaking directly to the camera, using expressive hand gestures to emphasize his points. Throughout the segment, a white banner at the top displays "whatsapp on 7827570775 to Contact, Consult & Appointments," with Hindi text below it reading "डॉ. से संपर्क, परामर्श, या अपॉइंटमेंट के लिए व्हाट्सअप करे" (Contact the doctor, consult, or for appointments, WhatsApp). A purple graphic with "SUBSCRIBE Dr. EDUCATION FOR MORE" is also visible in the bottom left corner. At 00:17, a white box with black text appears on the right, titled "# KEY POINTS To prevent the infection from spreading:". It lists several points including washing clothing, towels, and bedding in hot, soapy water, using a new towel and washcloth every time, cleaning bathroom fixtures, wearing clean clothes daily and not sharing them, and showering immediately after contact sports. Simultaneously, the Hindi text at the bottom changes to "वीडियो पसंद आये तो लाइक करके सबको बताइये - सही जानकारी सबको मिलनी चाहिए" (If you like the video, like and tell everyone - everyone should get the right information), and the top banner updates to "Like & Share our Videos to Friends & Spread Health Awareness".
